name: DeviantArt
description: DeviantArt is an online art gallery and creator community for browsing, publishing, organizing, discussing, following, messaging, and sharing visual art, literature, journals, and status updates.
agentUseSummary: Connect DeviantArt with Relay-owned OAuth 2.0 and the documented browse, collection, comment, feed, gallery, message, note, Sta.sh, user, and user.manage scopes. Agents can use the complete current endpoint families through a fixed allowlist: bounded reads run directly and every mutation is approval-gated in Safe mode. Fixed origins, paging and payload bounds, audits, redaction, token refresh, and mature-content parameters remain enforced.

credentialRequirements.name: DEVIANTART_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: DeviantArt client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay-owned OAuth application client ID issued by DeviantArt.

credentialRequirements.name: DEVIANTART_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: DeviantArt client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay-owned confidential-client secret stored only in Railway.

capabilities.label: Read DeviantArt resources
capabilities.description: Read the complete documented browse, collection, comment, data, deviation, feed, gallery, message, note, and user surface.

capabilities.label: Manage DeviantArt resources
capabilities.description: Manage collections, comments, deviations, feed settings, galleries, messages, notes, Sta.sh publishing, watches, profiles, and statuses.

allowed.label: Read DeviantArt
allowed.description: Run one allowlisted official read endpoint.

approvalRequired.label: Manage DeviantArt
approvalRequired.description: Run one allowlisted official mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

blocked.label: Expose DeviantArt secrets
blocked.description: OAuth client secrets, access and refresh tokens, cookies, and authorization headers are never exposed.

blocked.label: Use unofficial DeviantArt interfaces
blocked.description: Scraping, browser automation, arbitrary endpoints, private application calls, and raw token parameters are blocked.

blocked.label: Transfer unbounded content
blocked.description: Requests are bounded to one allowlisted endpoint, pages to 50, bodies to 2 MB, and responses to 5 MB.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; every mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected OAuth-authorized mutations run without Relay per-action approval; provider authority, fixed origins, allowlisted routes, bounds, audits, redaction, and provider rules still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives bounded allowlisted read and manage wrappers for the complete documented OAuth API surface.
Hermes receives the same bounded wrappers, selected capabilities, approval profile, and cloud-owned OAuth authority.

providerSetup.blocker: DeviantArt requires an authenticated developer application registration, client credentials, exact redirect URI, and user consent. No provider console was opened and no account, application, credential, or consent was created or captured in this task.
providerSetup.nextAction: The acceptance owner should register Relay with callback `https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/deviantart/callback`, store `DEVIANTART_CLIENT_ID` and `DEVIANTART_CLIENT_SECRET` in the approved Railway environment, then run staging PKCE consent, whoami, representative endpoint-family reads and mutations, refresh, revocation, mature-content, paging, and disconnect acceptance.

evidence.supports: DeviantArt documents Authorization Code OAuth, PKCE S256, confidential clients, access and refresh tokens, client credentials, revocation, and exact authorize/token/revoke endpoints.

The official live console lists the current browse, collections, comments, data, deviation, feed, gallery, messages, notes, Sta.sh, user, and util endpoint families and warns that mutations act on the connected account.
The official endpoint reference documents user.manage authority, typed publication fields, mature-content controls, and related deviation operations.
The official collection reference documents browse scope, a maximum page size of 50, offset pagination, mature-content parameters, and session-aware responses.
